name: github-extension-auth
description: GitHub OAuth token-exchange Azure Function for the ADO extension

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev && func pack --no-build -o dist && az functionapp deployment source config-zip -g $AZ_RESOURCE_GROUP -n func-tnit-ghrepoview --subscription $AZ_SUBSCRIPTION --src dist/auth.zip --build-remote false && npm install
